question: How many orders are in the database in total? Return an integer.
How many customers are based in France? Return an integer.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customers WHERE Country='France'

question: Total revenue all-time using the KPI docs Revenue definition. Return a float rounded to 2 decimals.
Top 3 categories by total revenue all-time. Return list[{category:str, revenue:float}].
gold_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice*od.Quantity*(1-od.Discount)),2) r FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryID ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many products are discontinued? Return an integer.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Products WHERE Discontinued='1'

question: Total quantity of the product 'Chai' sold in calendar year 2018. Return an integer.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(od.Quantity) FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID WHERE p.ProductName='Chai' AND date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31'

question: Total revenue in 2019 from orders shipped to the USA. Return a float rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice*od.Quantity*(1-od.Discount)),2) FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID WHERE o.ShipCountry='USA' AND date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'

question: Which customer placed the most orders in 2016? Return {customer:str, orders:int}.
gold_sql: SELECT cu.CompanyName, COUNT(*) n FROM Orders o JOIN Customers cu ON cu.CustomerID=o.CustomerID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31' GROUP BY cu.CustomerID ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of order lines in 2017 had a discount greater than zero? Return a float rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN od.Discount>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'

question: Which supplier generated the highest revenue in 2017? Return {supplier:str, revenue:float}.
gold_sql: SELECT s.CompanyName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice*od.Quantity*(1-od.Discount)),2) r FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Suppliers s ON s.SupplierID=p.SupplierID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' GROUP BY s.SupplierID ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct orders were placed during 'Winter Classics 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar? Return an integer.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders o WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-12-01' AND '2017-12-31'

question: Total revenue from the 'Condiments' category during 'Summer Beverages 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar. Return a float rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice*od.Quantity*(1-od.Discount)),2) FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID WHERE c.CategoryName='Condiments' AND date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-06-01' AND '2017-06-30'

question: Which employee handled the most orders all-time? Return {employee:str, orders:int} using the employee's last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.LastName, COUNT(*) n FROM Orders o JOIN Employees e ON e.EmployeeID=o.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: Top 5 products by total quantity sold in 2021. Return list[{product:str, quantity:int}].
gold_sql: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity) q FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31' GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 5
